%% Geometry deck: the text margins (a rule as wide as the line, under a line of text) and a frame title with a subtitle.
\setSlideVersion{1-0-0}
\begin{standardframe}{Text margins}
	\framesubtitle{and a subtitle under the title}
	The rule under this line is as wide as the text, from the left margin to the right one.\par
	\noindent\rule{\linewidth}{0.4pt}\par\smallskip
	\noindent This paragraph has no list around it and no indent, so its lines begin at the left text margin. It has to be long enough to fill more than three lines at this width, so here are a few more words, and then some more, until the paragraph has grown to a fair length for the measurement.
\end{standardframe}
